## Prepare Data

```{r}
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")
library(DESeq2)
library(stringdist)

# Function to calculate Levenshtein distance between two strings
calc_w_lev_dist <- function(str1, str2) {
  stringdist::stringdist(str1, str2, method = "lv", weight = c(0.99, 
                                                               0.99, 
                                                               0.01, 
                                                               0.01))
}

root_dir <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/"
list.files(root_dir)[grepl("min_threshold_clone-pass.csv", list.files(root_dir))]
```

## Load

```{r}
files <- list()

# Populate files
files[["S13"]] <- "13_VecF1_R2_S13_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv"
files[["S14"]] <- "14_VecF1_R2_S14_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv"
files[["S19"]] <- "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv"
files[["S20"]] <- "20_VecF2_R3_S20_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv"
files[["S21"]] <- "21_VecF4_R3_S21_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv" 

for (nm in names(files)){
  files[[nm]] <- read.csv(paste(root_dir, files[[nm]], sep = ''), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
}
```

```{r}
for (nm in names(files)){
  files[[nm]]$dist_nearest <- NULL
  files[[nm]]$clone_id <- NULL
}

for (nm in names(files)){
    print(nm)
    print(ncol(files[[nm]]))
}
```


```{r}
dat <- data.frame()
for (nm in names(files)){
  dat <- rbind(dat, files[[nm]])
}

rm(files)
```


```{r}
dat$clone_id <- NULL
dat$dist_nearest <- NULL

## Clonal Inference

cat("Calculating distToNearest...\n")

db <- shazam::distToNearest(dat, model = "ham", 
                    normalize = "len", 
                    vCallColumn = "v_call", 
                    jCallColumn = "j_call",
                    nproc = 4)

# Determine threshold (based on median)
thr <- summary(db$dist_nearest)[["Median"]]

new_thr <- thr + (thr*0.25)
print("25% Higher Threshold:")
print(round(new_thr, 2))

cat("Inferring Clones:\n")
system.time(
  # Clonal assignment using hierarchical clustering
  db <- scoper::hierarchicalClones(db, 
                                   threshold=new_thr,
                                   verbose = TRUE,
                                   v_call = "v_call", 
                                   j_call = "j_call",
                                   method = "aa",
                                   summarize_clones = FALSE)
)

# db <- db@db
```
